scenes.standard.components.narrative.tex:
Afternoon light falls through the museum's high windows. Beyond the entrance hall, voices drift between the marble pillars.

A curator waits beside a display of old maps. She looks up from her notes as you approach.

"You arrived just in time," she says. "We have found something unusual in the archives."

On the table lies a folded letter. Its seal bears the same crest you noticed above the locked gallery. Somewhere in the building, a clock begins to strike.

You take a closer look at the map. A route has been marked in faded blue ink, running from the old harbour to a place beyond the northern hills.

The curator turns a page in her notebook and waits for your answer.
